cnn.name: CNN (Convolutional Neural Network)
cnn.description: Deep 2D Convolutional Neural Network with 3x3 kernels, Max-Pooling, and Dropout for spatial feature hierarchy.

lenet5.name: LeNet-5
lenet5.description: Classic 1998 LeCun architecture featuring 5x5 convolutions and subsampling layers optimized for digit/character recognition.

ann.name: ANN (Artificial Neural Network)
ann.description: Fully-connected Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) with 256 and 128 hidden neurons utilizing ReLU activations.

svm.name: SVM (Support Vector Machine)
svm.description: Non-linear Radial Basis Function (RBF) margin classifier with Platt-calibrated probability estimation.

knn.name: KNN (K-Nearest Neighbors)
knn.description: Instance-based classification voting over 5 nearest neighbors in 784-dimensional pixel Euclidean space.

crnn.name: CRNN (Word & Sentence Recognition)
crnn.description: Convolutional Recurrent architecture with sequence segmentation for connected handwriting and words.
